data.message: i just lost 100 days by playing on a older save.

See I bought the game during the Steam Holiday sale and have only been playing for about a month or so and this mod was working just fine, then 2-3 days ago after I downloaded the afore mentioned mods it just stopped. I do not believe those mods had anything to do with it stopping working tho. I just wish it would start working again.

This had been working fine for me, but suddenly it just stopped working a couple of days ago and I have no idea as to why? SotF has not had any game updates since I installed this and it was working. I did install the Item Spawner mod, and the Open Sesame mod and Bow Trajectory mod, but I honestly do not think those mods would have any affect on whether or not this mod would work or not. I wish I knew why it had been working for about a month and all of a sudden just stopped working.

Broken trash mod, It would show up as it "Saved" but the next day me and my partner played again our saved game is not there, Don't get this mod if you want to waste hours on end for this shit mod to not save your game.
